entries.reason: Existing transaction protocol exposes independent domain stages to scripts without pair-specific modules.
protocol: Single-use owner-thread builder of owning ITransactionParticipant stages, canonical CostSpec and one payer; no arbitrary script commit callbacks or persistent/wire format.

Staging errors poison execution. Merged payment obeys maximum resource floors. Existing Coordinator handles rollback/compensation. VM-visible owner roots permit safe pending-batch disposal at VM shutdown.
entries.thread_affinity: Single VM/simulation owner thread; no reentry. Guards reject stale entity/account/tick before account access. Native callers retain borrowed stores; script owners are GC-visible retained roots until commit/disposal.

trim.evidence: L1 compile and L2 link: minimal+card+font+devtools with RTS=OFF linked an OBJECT host. L3 runtime: actual engine asserts RTS class absence, consumes a card, pays Mana plus ore via Economy and presents frames. Transaction has no Card/RTS/Economy includes; SHARED full scene also wins through the same batch protocol.

cost_notes.why: Independent domain stages and one merged reservation amortize work across an atomic request.
